body: Implemented: '+ Link ticket' in the detail opens a form with the relationship in both directions (e.g. 'is blocked by'), a ticket picker (search by key/title, keyboard navigable, self excluded) and a plain-language summary before linking. Each relationship has a remove button with inline confirmation and removes exactly that relationship ID. Core rejects duplicate edges (409 DUPLICATE_RELATION, under a lock) and blocking cycles (409 CYCLE); the UI explains both. DELETE /api/relations/:id returns 404 for an already removed edge.
author: local
